title: Now You Hear Me: Audio Narrative Attacks Against Large Audio–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of restricted/malicious directives when delivered using text-to-speech (TTS) audio with different psychologically grounded paralinguistic styles (e.g., authoritative demand, affiliative persuasion, emotive suggestion). This evaluates the model's social suggestibility and tendency to override safety alignments based on vocal authority or empathy.
